metadata.title: Outer trapped surface formation from gravitational waves collision
metadata.abstract: We give a new rigorous construction of outer trapped surface formation in smooth vacuum spacetimes without symmetry assumptions. The outer trapped surface is produced by the collision of two transversely localized, nearly plane-fronted gravitational waves described by short pulse data. The outer trapped surface is obtained by joining two smooth pieces along a curve with their future-directed outer null normals matching continuously. The incompleteness of the maximal future development is then established by adapting Penrose's original argument. This construction is inspired by Penrose's argument in constructing a marginally outer trapped surface in the collision of two ultra-relativistic particles modeled by the Aichelburg--Sexl solution.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在无对称假设的光滑真空时空中，构造两束横向局部化的近似平面引力短脉冲碰撞形成外陷面，并通过适应 Penrose 论证得到最大发展的未来不完备性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把碰撞启发转化为光滑真空框架中的严格形成构造。
analysis.limitations: 外陷面与双向陷面不同；具体面拼接正则性及初值条件应按正文理解。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 协助相关物理文献探索、物理问题澄清、计算检查及语言编辑。
